preview.title: Nirmatrelvir-Ritonavir and Symptoms in Adults With Postacute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 Infection: The STOP-PASC Randomized Clinical Trial
preview.preview: A 15-day nirmatrelvir–ritonavir course did not significantly improve the selected symptom outcomes in STOP-PASC. Participants already had long COVID, so the question differed from acute treatment or prevention. Symptoms improved in both groups. The small, selected, single-center population limits broader conclusions, and later trials still require full-text reconciliation. The source includes a correction to Figure 2.
preview.decisiveLimit: July 22 2024 correction repositions dashed lines in Figure 2. Current PMC article explicitly includes correction.

preview.title: Itraconazole, a commonly used anti-fungal that inhibits Hedgehog pathway activity and cancer growth
preview.preview: Itraconazole suppressed Hedgehog signaling in reporter and tumor models, with experiments locating its action near Smoothened. Fluconazole did not share this activity in the tested assay.
preview.decisiveLimit: Model-specific pathway inhibition is not a cancer-treatment outcome. Serum conditions materially changed potency.

preview.title: Cholesterol trafficking is required for mTOR activation in endothelial cells
preview.preview: Endothelial-cell experiments linked blocked intracellular cholesterol transport to reduced mTOR signaling and proliferation. Rescue experiments strengthened the proposed connection.
preview.decisiveLimit: Endothelial-cell assays do not establish tumor oxygenation, survival benefit or patient exposure at the target.

preview.title: Simultaneous Targeting of NPC1 and VDAC1 by Itraconazole Leads to Synergistic Inhibition of mTOR Signaling and Angiogenesis
preview.preview: Live-cell binding experiments identified NPC1 as an itraconazole target. The report linked cholesterol trafficking and a parallel AMPK pathway to suppression of endothelial growth.
preview.decisiveLimit: Cell and binding studies; clinical benefit was not tested. Supplementary methods and raw images need separate appraisal.

preview.title: Fenbendazole acts as a moderate microtubule destabilizing agent and causes cancer cell death by modulating multiple cellular pathways
preview.preview: Fenbendazole altered microtubules, cell division and metabolic readouts in lung-cancer models. These experiments explain a research rationale without establishing treatment benefit in people.
preview.decisiveLimit: No human cancer trial or safe human anticancer exposure was established. Laboratory selectivity is not clinical safety.

preview.title: Effects of Azole Antifungal Drugs on the Transition from Yeast Cells to Hyphae in Susceptible and Resistant Isolates of the Pathogenic Yeast Candida albicans
preview.preview: Fluconazole inhibited hyphal development in susceptible Candida isolates under specified laboratory conditions. Resistant isolates could retain this invasive-growth trait.
preview.decisiveLimit: Hyphal morphology is not direct measurement of human tissue invasion; results depended on strain, medium and exposure timing.

preview.title: Expression of fluconazole resistance-associated genes in biofilm from 23 clinical isolates of Candida albicans
preview.preview: Clinical Candida isolates became less susceptible to fluconazole as laboratory biofilms matured. The experiment does not support describing fluconazole as a general biofilm-destroying drug.
preview.decisiveLimit: Plate biofilms and a nonstandardized biofilm inoculum limit clinical interpretation; prevention is distinct from eradication.

preview.title: ULK-Atg13-FIP200 Complexes Mediate mTOR Signaling to the Autophagy Machinery
preview.preview: Genetic and biochemical experiments linked rapamycin-sensitive mTOR signaling to ULK–Atg13–FIP200 regulation and autophagic flux.
preview.decisiveLimit: A cellular mechanism cannot establish lifespan, anticancer or periodontal benefit in people.

preview.title: Phosphodiesterase inhibition restores hypoxia-induced cerebrovascular dysfunction subsequent to improved systemic redox homeostasis: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover study
preview.preview: A crossover experiment separated cerebral blood-velocity, regulation and oxygenation measurements. Changes in vascular regulation did not establish a general oxygenation benefit.
preview.decisiveLimit: Small healthy-male laboratory experiment; no disease-treatment outcome. Age values differ between abstract and Methods and need reconciliation.

preview.title: Tadalafil may improve cerebral perfusion in small-vessel occlusion stroke—a pilot study
preview.preview: A small crossover trial detected a modest cortical oxygenation signal after tadalafil. It did not establish a general increase in brain blood flow or a clinical benefit.
preview.decisiveLimit: Small pilot; NIRS superficial/possibly extracranial; no cognition or recurrent-stroke benefit demonstrated.

preview.title: The PASTIS trial: Testing tadalafil for possible use in vascular cognitive impairment
preview.preview: PASTIS directly measured brain perfusion by MRI. A single tadalafil dose did not significantly increase the prespecified subcortical blood-flow measures.
preview.decisiveLimit: A short mechanistic trial cannot establish dementia prevention or long-term treatment benefit.

preview.title: Randomized Trial of Metformin, Ivermectin, and Fluvoxamine for Covid-19
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: A well-blinded factorial trial with a negative primary outcome, a noisy oximetry component and favorable but multiplicity-unadjusted secondary outcomes. It is one trial family shared with the viral-load and long-term reports.

preview.title: MA.32: Metformin versus placebo and invasive disease-free survival in breast cancer
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: Large, blinded randomized evidence with long follow-up is negative for the primary clinical endpoint. Metabolic companion results and exploratory HER2 findings do not overturn it. Discordant adverse-event numbers are explicitly retained rather than silently recalculated.

preview.title: Metformin versus placebo: metabolic factors in MA.32
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: A large but selected paired-sample analysis supports metabolic effects. It is not independent cancer-efficacy evidence, and the subsequent negative clinical endpoint prevents interpreting improved biomarkers as proven cancer benefit.

preview.title: Metformin in advanced pancreatic cancer: double-blind randomized phase II trial
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: Blinded randomized phase II evidence shows no survival benefit and more dose modification with metformin. Exploratory exposure-response observations cannot establish that higher doses work.

preview.title: Metformin in patients with type 2 diabetes and kidney disease: a systematic review
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: A useful historical synthesis with explicit limitations from rare events, heterogeneous definitions and confounding. It is unsuitable as current prescribing authority; current labeling supersedes its 2014 regulatory description.

preview.title: Metformin for chemoprevention of recurrent colorectal adenoma or polyps
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: Promising randomized evidence for one-year lesion recurrence in a selected population, limited by sample size, missing colonoscopies, multiplicity and surrogate outcomes. It does not establish reduced colorectal cancer incidence or mortality.

preview.title: Metformin with chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced NSCLC: OCOG-ALMERA
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: Primary failure, conventional PFS, OS and severe toxicity all favored control. Small size and imbalances limit causal detail, but the results must be prominent in a guide considering anticancer use.

preview.title: Metformin suppresses colorectal aberrant crypt foci in a short-term clinical trial
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: A small unblinded pilot with blinded assessment, substantial metformin-arm attrition and within-group hypothesis tests. It supplies preliminary biological context, not a reliable between-group cancer-prevention effect.

preview.title: Favorable Antiviral Effect of Metformin on SARS-CoV-2 Viral Load in a Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Clinical Trial of COVID-19
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: The randomized comparison supports a modest RNA-load effect in an optional substudy, subject to missingness and selection. It does not directly establish infectivity, transmission or clinical benefit and shares its trial family with the other COVID-OUT reports.

preview.title: Metformin blunts muscle hypertrophy in response to progressive resistance exercise training in older adults: The MASTERS trial
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: A useful randomized interaction study, limited by completer analysis and multiple outcomes. The registered primary fiber-area endpoint was null; DXA and CT support attenuation of some muscle-mass gains. The actual corrigendum is incorporated into relative-strength estimates.

preview.title: Metformin and physical performance in older people with probable sarcopenia and physical prefrailty or frailty in England (MET-PREVENT): a double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: High follow-up retention makes the null primary result informative despite frequent treatment discontinuation. The reported primary interval excludes the targeted 0.1 m/s benefit. Tolerability and hospital admissions require prominent discussion, without attributing every event causally.

preview.title: Metformin induces autophagy and cell-cycle arrest in myeloma by targeting AMPK and mTOR
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: Cell and xenograft activity supplies a hypothesis, not clinical efficacy. High cell concentrations, small unblinded animal comparisons and limited toxicology prevent therapeutic extrapolation.

preview.title: Addition of metformin to concurrent chemoradiation in locally advanced non-small-cell lung cancer
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: Randomized phase II evidence did not show improved progression-free or overall survival. Open-label treatment, incomplete dosing and broad confidence intervals limit precision, while blinded imaging review supports the robustness of the null comparison.

preview.title: Metformin Prevents Dopaminergic Neuron Death in MPTP/P-Induced Mouse Model of Parkinson’s Disease via Autophagy and Mitochondrial ROS Clearance
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: Small randomized toxin-model experiments and cell assays support a mechanistic hypothesis. They do not establish efficacy, a dose, safety or disease modification in humans.

preview.title: Metformin improves cognitive impairment in patients with schizophrenia: associated with enhanced functional connectivity of dorsolateral prefrontal cortex
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: A positive cognitive test finding with substantial limits: open-label treatment, small sample, multiple analyses and incomplete functional assessment. The later mechanistic paper is a companion, not independent replication.

preview.title: Metformin for metastatic prostate cancer: STAMPEDE randomized phase 3 trial
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: Large randomized evidence does not demonstrate overall survival improvement in the metastatic cohort. Metabolic effects are real intermediate findings in a smaller available-case subset. The high-volume survival subgroup lacks a convincing interaction and cannot overturn the primary result.

preview.title: Evidence that metformin exerts its anti-diabetic effects through inhibition of complex 1 of the mitochondrial respiratory chain
preview.preview: Source assessment prepared; independent review is pending.
preview.decisiveLimit: Substrate-specific and concentration/time-dependent experiments support a complex-I hypothesis. Isolation artifacts, high assay concentrations and small nonhuman samples limit extrapolation; clinical repurposing efficacy is not tested.

preview.title: The Effect of Fluvoxamine and Metformin for Fatigue in Patients With Long COVID: An Adaptive Randomized Trial (replacement report)
preview.preview: Replacement report assessed with dose-change and futility information retained. Independent review is pending.

A substantive main-report appraisal is complete, but unavailable final SAP, code, journal supplement and disclosure files prevent labeling the full packet independently verified.
